svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 06 · Merced · 01/12 Lake Yosemite (Legendary)
svg.desc: The lake just past the edge of campus. Early in the morning it holds the whole sky. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
